gloss: one of them; some one; any one

definitions.gloss: one of them; some one (of several); any one (of several)
definitions.explanation: An indefinite pronoun referring to an unspecified item from a group of three or more things.

examples.japanese: どれか{一|ひと}つ{選|えら}んでください。
この{中|なか}でどれかお{気|き}に{入|い}りはありますか。
examples.english: Is there one among these that you like?

examples.japanese: {三|みっ}つの{案|あん}のうちどれかに{決|き}めなければならないが、どれも{一長一短|いっちょういったん}がある。
examples.english: I have to decide on one of the three proposals, but each has its pros and cons.

notes:
Formed from どれ (which one) + か (indefinite marker). Used when selecting from three or more items. For choosing between two items, どちらか is used instead. The か particle converts the interrogative どれ into an indefinite pronoun.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どれか{一|ひと}つ: one of them
- どれかに{決|き}める: to decide on one of them
- どれかを{選|えら}ぶ: to choose one of them
- 〜のうちどれか: one of ~

RELATED INDEFINITE PRONOUNS:
- どこか: somewhere
- だれか: someone
- なにか: something
- どちらか: one of two; either one
- いつか: sometime
